name: clever-pv
description: Home energy management (HEMS) for your clever-PV system: PV surplus, battery storage, wallbox, heat pump, dynamic electricity tariffs and forecasts.

interface.longDescription:
Use electricity when it is cheap – and get more out of your devices.

clever-PV connects your home energy management with ChatGPT. Ask about your consumption, compare energy data and change settings right in the conversation. With or without a solar system, clever-PV helps you use electricity more efficiently and lower your energy costs.

One platform for your devices
clever-PV supports more than 800 devices from over 100 manufacturers. Connect compatible PV systems, battery storage, wallboxes, electric cars, heat pumps and other appliances in one energy management system – cloud-based and without additional hardware.

Optimise automatically for sunshine and electricity prices
Use your own solar power with PV surplus control and shift suitable consumption to cheap periods of your dynamic electricity tariff. PV and energy forecasts let clever-PV take expected production and consumption into account.

Understand your energy and adjust settings
With the plugin you can check devices and their current state, analyse energy data, and look up electricity prices, tariffs and forecasts. Visual views bring your devices and energy data straight into the chat. On your explicit request, you can change supported device functions and optimisation settings.

For example, try:
• "How has my electricity consumption changed compared with last month?"
• "What is currently preventing my battery from charging?"
• "When will grid electricity be particularly cheap for me tomorrow?"

clever-PV keeps optimising automatically outside the chat as well.

A clever-PV app account is required. Available functions depend on your devices; the plugin can query and adjust a subset of them.
